reviewerA: FAIL: deadline could expire during encoding/fsync and Math.max(1, remainder) could launch CLI
resolution: Confirmed deadline issue on its merits. Positive remaining time is rechecked after durable marker immediately before spawnSync and used directly. Three local VM boundary checks pass. Local inspect now awaits stdout completion before exit: direct process.exit truncated piped JSON, and synchronous stdout hit EAGAIN on the small nonblocking pipe; the awaited stream write passes complete JSON capture.
